text.p: These are the leading stories in Albania's main newspapers on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
KOHA JONE
- The paper's front-page headline says Leka is the "king" that sheds blood. Its editorial says Leka, son of Albania's late King Zog, sank the monarchist dream.
- A man died and two people were wounded after shots were fired in a rally staged by supporters of the monarchy.
- Albanian Prime Minister Bashkim Fino has asked Leka to denounce his own his leadership of a demonstration in front of the offices of the Central Election Commission.
- Albanian President Sali Berisha has sacked Interior Minister Belul Celo who said he had not handed over his resignation.
- Justice Minister Spartak Ngjela, appointed to the post by the monarchist party in the 10-party unity government, said he respected only legal ways of solving problems.
- Three shots have been fired at the car carrying Social Democratic Party chairman Skender Gjinushi and a French journalist from the seat of the Democratic Party in the southern town of Fier.
GAZETA SHQIPTARE

- President Sali Berisha wants to postpone a second round of parliamentary elections after his party lost heavily in the first. The OSCE has urged the Central Election Commission to speed up the procedures for the vote to take place.

- OSCE envoy Franz Vranitzky has launched an ultimatum to Albanian election authorities to hold the second round of elections on July 6, saying the deadline for printing the ballot papers by the OSCE had passed.
- Prime Minister Fino charged President Berisha with violating the constitution after Berisha named a new commander of the republican guard.
- Interior Minister Belul Celo returned from Greece and tendered his resignation. Ali Kazazi of the Democratic Party has replaced him.
- Two policemen have been killed in the southern region of Berat and two brothers were killed in the southern region of Vlore while they were crying over the grave of their brother.
ALBANIA
- Two people have been killed during a demonstration of supporters of the monarchy, who claim Albanians have voted for the monarchy in a referendum on Sunday.
RILINDJA DEMOKRATIKE
- President Berisha advised Albanian monarchists and Socialists to avoid conflicts.
- The paper's frontpage headline accuses Socialists of shedding blood in Tirana.
ZERI I POPULLIT
- The paper's front-page headline said the bandits of Leka Zogu shed blood in Tirana and accused Berisha and his Democratic Party of shielding the crime.
